title: Repeated authentication failures
description: Synthetic authentication records with repeated failures.
explanation: Repeated failures can indicate password guessing; confirm against the identity provider and expected user activity.

title: Suspicious login pattern
description: Synthetic login from an unusual location and time.

records.message: new country login at unusual hour

explanation: An unusual successful login is a review signal, not proof of compromise.

title: Port-scan-like log pattern
description: Synthetic host records show many destination ports.
explanation: Repeated port probes warrant checking authorized scanner schedules and network telemetry.

title: Unusual outbound traffic
description: Synthetic record with anomalous outbound volume.
explanation: Review the destination, process, and baseline before treating this volume anomaly as malicious.

title: Suspicious DNS activity
description: Synthetic DNS record with a long, encoded-looking query label.

records.message: suspicious dns query with unusually long encoded domain label

explanation: Long DNS labels may be benign; inspect resolver logs and domain context.

title: Web application error spike
description: Synthetic web logs with elevated server errors.
explanation: Correlate server errors with deployment and request logs; error spikes alone do not establish an attack.

title: Unexpected privilege change
description: Synthetic record for a privilege change outside the normal window.
explanation: Verify the change against approved access requests and audit records.

title: Unexpected file access
description: Synthetic record for unusual access to a sensitive file.

records.message: unexpected access to sensitive file outside normal pattern

explanation: Confirm the actor, resource, and business context with file audit logs.

title: Repeated rate-limit events
description: Synthetic API gateway logs with repeated throttling.
explanation: Check for client retries, load tests, and expected service behavior before escalation.

title: Unusual administrative actions
description: Synthetic audit record for an unexpected admin action.

records.message: unusual administrative action outside approved window

explanation: Validate the actor, change ticket, and administrative audit trail.

title: Potential data-exfiltration indicator
description: Synthetic outbound transfer record; no real traffic is generated.

records.message: potential data exfiltration indicator synthetic transfer

explanation: Review destination and data handling records; this synthetic heuristic is not confirmation of exfiltration.

title: Benign scheduled activity
explanation: No included rule matched this routine maintenance record.
